title: ewl-nash-certification: certifying quantum Nash equilibria of the EWL game under hardware noise (code, data and IBM Quantum hardware results)
description: Code and data for the paper 'Certifying quantum Nash equilibria under hardware noise: a finite-circuit test, T1/T2 stability conditions and an experiment on a superconducting processor'. Contains an exact density-matrix model of the Eisert-Wilkens-Lewenstein Prisoner's Dilemma with noise, the six-circuit quadratic-form certification test, closed-form T1/T2 stability conditions, device-calibrated simulations on six IBM processor snapshots, and the raw counts and analysis of two runs on ibm_kingston (IBM Heron r2, 18 October 2026). Every number, table and figure of the paper can be regenerated.
